annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Council Decision on the position to be taken on behalf of the European Union on the Draft Recommendation of the Committee of Ministers of the Council of Europe on equality and artificial intelligence
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Council Decision on the position to be taken on behalf of the European Union on the Draft Recommendation of the Committee of Ministers of the Council of Europe on equality and artificial intelligence
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Commission proposal for a Council Decision setting the EU position on the draft Council of Europe Recommendation on equality and AI. The EU would not object to adoption provided the text stays consistent with the EU AI Act and the CoE Framework Convention, without extra obligations or broader high-risk sectors. Legal basis: Articles 114 and 218(9) TFEU.
key_provisions_or_claims: EU to agree to the CoE Recommendation only if consistent with the AI Act and the Framework Convention.
Measures must not exceed AI Act obligations or add positive equality duties for providers and deployers.
Human review and appeal safeguards must be consistent with the AI Act, with no new AI-specific obligations.
Sectors needing particular attention must not go beyond the AI Act high-risk areas (Annexes I and III).
Legal basis is Article 114 TFEU with Article 218(9) TFEU; the position is expressed by Member States jointly.
